Step2 · Repeated-estimate variability

Four times the samples: does every error halve?

At the same point count N, a different set of points gives another π̂. Choose 20 seeds at once, then use the paused N=100, 400 and 1600 comparisons: their endpoints differ. Four times N halves the theoretical standard error (SE). Neither one actual error nor the sample standard deviation of 20 estimates must halve. The pale band uses known π and model SE as a teaching reference, not a confidence interval.

Keep the current mode and seeds, pause, and replay their first N points. The 100→400 comparison uses nested prefixes, not two fresh independent batches. Use the original New seed button to change seeds.

N per estimate = 100 · Sample SD of 20 π̂ values = 0.1685 (denominator 19) · Theoretical SE of one estimate = 0.1642 · 20 seeds starting at 42

The known π ± 2SE band compares error scales; the point estimate still uses actual hits. This is not a sample-derived interval for unknown π, nor a guarantee for 20 paths or an entire trajectory. A large-N normal approximation can discuss probability at a fixed N, but no exact 95% coverage is promised here. The fixed plot window 2.62..3.66 clips the drawing, not the readouts.

Which variance is which? (expand)

Write an inside hit as X=1, otherwise 0; π̂ = 4 × mean(X). This teaching example knows p=π/4 for checking theory. Seeded pseudorandom streams make the display reproducible; they do not prove independence.

Population variance of one 0/1 observation: p(1−p)
0.168548
Sample variance sX² inside the first current run
0.135758
Theoretical variance of repeated same-N π estimates: Var(π̂)
0.026968
Standard error of that estimator: SE(π̂)
0.164218

sX² = N/(N−1)·p̂(1−p̂) for N≥2; Var(π̂) = 16p(1−p)/N; SE = √Var(π̂). N counts points in one estimate, not 20 replications. The sample SD of 20 estimates approximates the SE scale of one estimate. Do not divide it again by √20: that would target the SE of their average.

At N=0 there is no estimate or SE; sample variance needs N≥2. All hits or all misses may produce observed sample variance 0 without proving zero uncertainty in an unknown model. Here SE uses known p; inference for an unknown p needs a separately constructed interval.

Source: variance and standard error of a mean · Interval inference and small-sample limits

第2步 · 重复估计的波动

样本四倍，每次误差都减半吗？

同样的点数N，换一组点就会得到另一个π̂。先选20颗种子同跑，用下方N=100、400、1600暂停对照：20条轨迹的末端并不重合。N四倍时，理论标准误差SE减半；一次实际误差、20次估计的样本标准差都不保证精确减半。图中的浅带用已知π和理想模型SE作教学参照，不是置信区间。

继续长跑
换一颗种子
重置

参考带是已知π±2SE，帮助比较误差尺度；π仍由实际命中数估计。它不是从样本构造的未知π区间，也不保证20条或整段轨迹都在带内。充分大N时可用正态近似讨论固定N的概率，但这里不承诺精确95%覆盖。图窗固定2.62..3.66，越界仅裁切画面，数值读数不裁切。

这些方差各指什么？（可展开）

把一次点是否落在圆内写成X=1或0，π̂=4×X的平均。本教学例知道p=π/4，可核对理论；伪随机种子用于可重复展示，不证明点列独立。

单个0/1观测的总体方差 p(1−p)
0.168548
当前第1条轨迹内的样本方差 sX²
0.164856
同样N重复估π的理论方差 Var(π̂)
0.006742
上述估计量的标准误差 SE(π̂)
0.082109

sX²=N/(N−1)·p̂(1−p̂)（N≥2）；Var(π̂)=16p(1−p)/N；SE=√Var(π̂)。N是每次估计内的点数，不是20次重复。20个估计值的样本标准差近似反映单次估计的SE尺度，不要再除以√20；后者会换成20次均值的SE。

N=0时尚无估计或SE；N<2不能计算样本方差。全中／全未中可使观察到的样本方差为0，却不能据此断言未知模型没有不确定性。本例使用已知p的理论SE；一般未知p的推断区间需要另行构造。

读依据：平均值方差与标准误差 · 区间推断与小样本边界
